newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-WMC plans new gold processing plant.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-WMC plans new gold processing plant.

text.p: WMC Ltd said on Friday it has approved an A$157 million capital programme to construct a new gold processing plant at St Ives in Western Australia to treat initially five million tonnes of ore and ultimately seven millions tonnes per year.
WMC said it had concurrently decided to offer the Hill 50 operation at Mt Magnet for sale by way of tender and this would be undertaken during the first quarter of 1997.

"When completed in 1998, we expect the annual gold producion from St Ives to increase from the current level of around 400,000 ounces per annum to around 550,000 ounces per annum and subsequently 700,000 ounces per annum as further gold reserves are proven," WMC chairman Sir Arvi Parbo told the company's annual meeting of shareholders.

"With the concentration on the St Ives district gold potential, the company has concurrently decided to offer the Hill 50 operation at Mount Magnet for sale by way of tender and this will be undertaken during the first quarter of 1997," Parbo said.
